sections.title: Special Topics in Higher Ed: How AI is Changing Higher Education
sections.description: This course will explore how generative AI and other forms of artificial intelligence are changing higher education in the United States. Topics include ethical questions about AI, how academic writing and publishing are changing in response to AI, and the historical and social contexts for adopting new educational technology. Students will use large language models (LLMs) and other AI tools in preparing for class, assess the educational value of AI tools for higher education, and discuss questions raised by the use of AI by individuals and institutions.
